hearings.title: Parent Appearances
hearings.guidance:
Which parents personally appeared and how (in person or remotely). An
appearance by counsel only is not a parent appearance; if no parent
personally appeared, the category is null.

hearings.title: Evidence Considered
hearings.guidance:
Testimony, reports, exhibits, records, and stipulations the court
considered, plus evidentiary objections and rulings on evidence. Do not
include argument or orders here.

hearings.title: Testimony
hearings.guidance:
Witnesses who were verified as sworn and the material substance of their
sworn testimony. Q/A formatting alone does not establish testimony; unsworn
colloquy belongs in evidence, not here. If no sworn testimony occurred, the
category is null.

hearings.title: Disputed Legal Issues
hearings.guidance:
Contested legal or procedural questions argued or decided at the hearing.
Undisputed matters and routine calendar rulings do not belong here; if
nothing was disputed, the category is null.

hearings.title: Party Positions and Reasons
hearings.guidance:
Each party's position and the stated reasoning, with distinct attribution
by role. A party without a stated position is omitted; if no positions were
stated, the category is null.

hearings.title: Court Orders and Reasons
hearings.guidance:
Major findings and orders the court actually made and the court's stated
reasons, emphasizing rulings on contested matters. Never include proposed
or recommended findings or orders as if made.

reports.title: Agency Recommendations
reports.guidance:
The agency's substantive recommendations to the court, stated apart from
any formal proposed-findings-and-orders template, with accurate agency
attribution.

reports.title: Petition Events
reports.guidance:
Material developments in the petition and case posture described in the
report, including new filings, hearings noted, and procedural posture
changes.

reports.title: Allegations, Interviews, and Evidence
reports.guidance:
Allegations, interviews, observations, and supporting evidence the report
describes, including who was interviewed and material discrepancies.

reports.title: Disputed Issues and Party Positions
reports.guidance:
Contested questions and each party's stated position with distinct
attribution; if nothing was disputed, the category is null.

reports.title: Court Findings and Orders
reports.guidance:
Findings and orders actually made by the court, including ones the report
historically recites, never proposed or recommended templates offered for
adoption.

reports.title: Reunification Barriers
reports.guidance:
Barriers to reunification the report identifies, including confirmed
barriers the agency documents and reasons the agency gives.

reports.title: New Setbacks or Material Changes
reports.guidance:
Setbacks, regressions, or material changes in circumstances the report
describes as current or recent developments.

reports.title: Indian Ancestry
reports.guidance:
Indian ancestry or tribal affiliation notices, inquiries, findings, and
their disposition. If the report says nothing responsive, the category is
null.

reports.title: Services Progress
reports.guidance:
Court-ordered services, enrollment, participation, compliance, and progress
or lack of progress the report describes.

reports.title: Visitation
reports.guidance:
Visitation frequency, supervision status, and quality as described in the
report, including reported problems or cessation.

reports.title: Parent-Child Relationship
reports.guidance:
The report's description of each parent's relationship, bond, and
interaction with the child.

reports.title: Placement and Caregiver Approval
reports.guidance:
Placement status and changes, caregiver assessment, and any placement- or
adoption-approval posture the report describes.
